baseline: Previously accepted RC ECO (C2=220nF; R2=(26.5,20)mm), not the earlier 100nF/pre-move version

testpoint.schematic_placement: Automatic near C2 on the root sheet; no manual coordinates/rotation are requested
testpoint.unconnected_definition: TP1.1 is an isolated singleton with a no-connect marker; native auto-generated unconnected net name is not a tenth intended named net

protected: All original component references/UUID relationships/footprints/pad numbers/values/positions/rotations/layers
All channel 1,3,4 logical pin maps and copper geometry/UUIDs
Original GND tracks/vias and zone definitions; fills separately rechecked
Original board outline geometry; rule severities and ignored checks

rules.rename_assignment_policy: Retain numeric rules and existing-net assignments. If rename does not propagate assignment, explicitly apply the existing RC4 values to OUT2_SENSE; an unused old-name assignment may remain. Do not relax any rule.

requirements.schema_metadata: Top-level wrapper extra keys are caller metadata, not edit operations; named text fields retain existing semantics.

pcb_strategy.lifecycle: The same absolute PCB and schematic paths throughout S0-S5. Never switch to a main board without TP history. Every stage must save, reopen, compare intent/geometry, run native checks and review new full images.
pcb_strategy.removal: S4 explicitly disconnects the schematic pin, syncs and repairs only OUT2_SENSE copper. S5 removes the schematic TP1 and uses project sync --remove-footprint with its exact saved identity/pad selection. Refuse contact/locks/ambiguity instead of removing whole nets. Refill saved zones through public CLI; every original footprint, non-target copper and rule remains protected.

stages: S0 exact frozen RC ECO baseline; fresh native read and images
S1 OUT2 -> OUT2_SENSE; same PCB sync and explicit effective-rule retention
S2 add TP1 with pin1 NC; same PCB add and place at (55,32) mm
S3 connect TP1.1 to OUT2_SENSE; value MONITOR_OUT2; same PCB sync and actual selected-net copper connectivity
S4 disconnect TP1.1 with NC; same PCB sync and selected-net copper repair; no copper contact to TP1
S5 remove TP1 in schematic and explicitly remove the exact PCB identity; save/reopen/refill, compare all original objects and S4 copper, prove no TP attachments/UUID references remain
acceptance: Full pin membership and identities at each stage, fresh native saved-file XML/PCB reads, native ERC where applicable; native DRC for completed PCB stages. Full images and explicit current snapshot-bound visual verdict. No design electrical/ampacity/supplier sign-off.

revision_reason.purpose: Explicit new same-board lifecycle acceptance requested before execution; preserve v2 separate retention-board result and failure.
revision_reason.changed_requirement: One project PCB participates in every S0-S5 stage, including physical explicit TP deletion; original input bytes and all numeric/identity protections unchanged.
